mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_error, locked_at, locked_by, created_at, published_at FROM outbox_events WHERE attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND locked_at <= #{leaseCutoff}) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'SENDING', attempts = attempts + 1, locked_at = #{now}, locked_by = #{workerId}, last_error = NULL WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'SENT', published_at = #{publishedAt}, locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = #{now}, last_error = 'Publisher lease expired after the maximum number of attempts', locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND locked_at <= #{leaseCutoff} AND attempts >= #{maxAttempts}
